semiconductor_relevance: High — AETS Co., Ltd. provides specialized equipment and solutions for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in wafer recycling and cleaning.
summary: AETS Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced cleaning solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, including the recycling of 300mm wafers and the cleaning of quartz products used in LPCVD processes. Their innovative technologies enhance efficiency and environmental sustainability in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Quartz product cleaning for LPCVD processes
technical_expertise: environmental control systems in semiconductor fabs

regional_presence.Korea: AETS Co., Ltd. is based in Korea and focuses on providing innovative solutions for the domestic semiconductor industry.
